UKHSA group A streptococcal second seasonal update
updated seasonal group A streptococcal surveillance
The publication updates seasonal group A streptococcal activity in England.
It covers scarlet fever and invasive group A streptococcal indicators.
scabies_landing
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/scabies-management-advice-for-health-professionals
UKHSA scabies management publication
national management of classical and crusted scabies cases and outbreaks
The publication supports public-health management of classical and crusted scabies.
It addresses prevention and control of outbreaks.
scabies_communal_settings

https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/scabies-management-advice-for-health-professionals/ukhsa-guidance-on-the-management-of-scabies-cases-and-outbreaks-in-long-term-care-facilities-and-other-closed-settings
UKHSA communal-settings scabies guidance
scabies case and outbreak control in long-term-care and closed settings
The guidance covers scabies cases and outbreaks in communal residential settings.
It describes close skin-to-skin contact as the usual transmission route.
vhf_collection
https://www.gov.uk/government/collections/viral-haemorrhagic-fevers-epidemiology-characteristics-diagnosis-and-management
UKHSA viral haemorrhagic fever collection
VHF diagnosis, management and disease-specific guidance
The collection covers Ebola, Marburg, Lassa and Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever.
It directs samples with clinical and travel history to the Rare and Imported Pathogens Laboratory.
vhf_origins_transmission
https://www.gov.uk/guidance/viral-haemorrhagic-fevers-origins-reservoirs-transmission-and-guidelines
UKHSA VHF origins and transmission guidance
VHF reservoirs, transmission routes, HCID classification and prevention
The guidance describes reservoirs and transmission routes for multiple haemorrhagic-fever viruses.
It identifies several VHFs as UK high-consequence infectious diseases.
vhf_acdp_landing
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/viral-haemorrhagic-fever-acdp-algorithm-and-guidance-on-management-of-patients
DHSC ACDP VHF patient-management publication
specialist VHF risk assessment, infection control and patient management
The publication provides specialist VHF patient-management and infection-control guidance.
It includes a risk-assessment algorithm.
vhf_acute_hospitals

https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/viral-haemorrhagic-fever-acdp-algorithm-and-guidance-on-management-of-patients/risk-assessment-and-immediate-management-of-viral-haemorrhagic-fevers-contact-high-consequence-infectious-diseases-in-acute-hospitals
ACDP acute-hospital VHF management guidance
acute-hospital risk assessment and immediate management of contact-HCID VHFs
The guidance supports assessment and management of suspected or confirmed VHF in UK acute hospitals.
It aims to minimise transmission to healthcare workers and other contacts.
vhf_testing_landing
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/viral-haemorrhagic-fever-sample-testing-advice
UKHSA VHF sample-testing publication
arranging VHF tests through the Imported Fever Service
The publication explains the pathway for arranging VHF sample testing.
It identifies samples to be taken and expected result turnaround.
vhf_testing_detail
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/viral-haemorrhagic-fever-sample-testing-advice/viral-haemorrhagic-fever-vhf-sample-testing-from-the-imported-fever-service
UKHSA detailed VHF sample-testing guidance
RIPL PCR panels, exposure-based testing and urgent result handling
The guidance describes exposure-based VHF PCR testing at RIPL.
Panels may include Ebola, Marburg, Lassa and Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever.
